main_text.l: tatus Hiberniæ, cujus opera sereniss. regem contra
animi sui impetum ad violenta hæc consilia protru-
sum paucis ignotum fuerat: promulgatur etiam e-
dictum, quo non solum Scoti qui in Angliam cum
armato exercitu ingredercntur, verumetiam omnes
eorum fautores qui eis pecuniam, apparatum bel-
licum, commeatum suppeditarent, rebelles & læ-
sæ majestatis rei declarantur, gratia interim iis ob-
lata qui armis depositis domum sese conferrent, ac
præterita crimina submisse deprecarentur.
Verum terriculamentis hisce dimoveri non po-
tuerunt Scoti ab instituto: & exercitu recensito
qui 27 aut 28. millibus peditum & quatuor milli-
bus equitum constabat, movere castra Angliam
versus præcipite Augusto imperat Leslius, quem pa-
triæ suæ in extremis angustiis laboranti reddidit
Dominus: Huic summam belli commisisse Scotos,
supra dictum: Totus exercitus ad commodiorem
frumentationem in tria agmina divisus: Primum
ducebat Aumontius, aliud Baylius tertium ipse Leslius,
cum ingenti apparatu bellico & multorum dierum
commeatu: Transmittendus erat Tueda fluvius An-
gliam à Scotia disterminans; & hic honos Comiti
montis Rosarum peditum tribuno forte obtigit; qui ex
equo descendens, pedes flumen ad ordinarium va-
dum primus pertransiit, quod ab aliis omnibus pe-
ditum ductoribus factitatum, ut gregariis mili-ti-
bus animos adderent, ex æquato scilic. omnium la-
bore & periculo. In hosticum cum castrametaren-
tur, severe omnibus sub pœna capitis interdictum,
ne nulla injuria Anglos eorumque villas, agros, bo-
na afficerent: præsidiarii interim Berwicenses huc at-
illuc discurrebant, ut milites sessos aut palantes ab
agminibus interciperent; sed nullo prorsus operæ-
pretio: Nam 28. Augusti, ad condictum locum eri-
cetum videlic. Novocastrense, in sinistra Tinæ flu-
minis

page.notes: The blue highlighting over "27", "28." and "28. Augusti," is a colour mark on the scan, not printed; the numbers are copied as printed. "condictum" is read as printed; the letters are clear but the word is unusual. The first line is a fragment continuing from the previous page. The last word "minis" stands alone at the right of the scan and is set as the end of the paragraph. No catchword or signature is visible. The "Nam 28. Augusti," line is italic-looking in the scan but I have marked only that line's phrase as italic.
